message.content: {"question":"If δ = kv where k is a constant, determine v = v(t) and x = x(t) knowing that x(0) = 0 and v(0) = 0","options":{"A":"x(t) = -exp(-kt)/k + 1/k; v(t) = exp(-kt) - 1","B":"x(t) = -exp(-kt) + 1; v(t) = exp(-kt) - 1","C":"x(t) = -exp(-kt)/k + v(t) = exp(-kt)","D":"x(t) = -exp(-kt)/k + v(t) = exp(-kt) - 1"},"correct":"A"}
